lines.en: Dan, our group got caught in a storm last weekend, but I had packed a jacket in case it rained.
lines.pt: Dan, nosso grupo foi pego por uma tempestade no fim de semana, mas eu tinha levado uma jaqueta caso chovesse.

lines.en: I heard that. A large number of walkers got stuck, and both of the main paths got closed by the rangers.
lines.pt: Fiquei sabendo. Um grande número de caminhantes ficou preso, e os dois caminhos principais foram fechados pelos guardas.

lines.en: Neither of us panicked. Each of us had water and a map in case the signal disappeared, so we stayed calm.
lines.pt: Nenhum de nós entrou em pânico. Cada um tinha água e um mapa caso o sinal sumisse, então ficamos calmos.

lines.en: I always take less weight and fewer things, but I never forget extra batteries in case my light dies.
lines.pt: Sempre levo menos peso e menos coisas, mas nunca esqueço pilhas extras caso minha lanterna morra.

lines.en: A great deal of the trail got flooded, so we walked much more slowly, and many boots were ruined.
lines.pt: Boa parte da trilha ficou alagada, então andamos muito mais devagar, e muitas botas se estragaram.

lines.en: Did anyone get hurt? If someone had twisted an ankle, you would have needed a doctor quickly.
lines.pt: Alguém se machucou? Se alguém tivesse torcido o tornozelo, vocês teriam precisado de um médico rápido.

lines.en: The ranger told us that fewer visitors would come next week because the path was being repaired.
lines.pt: O guarda nos disse que menos visitantes viriam semana que vem porque o caminho estava sendo consertado.

lines.en: If the trail gets reopened, I will invite each of you, in case you want to try again.
lines.pt: Se a trilha for reaberta, convido cada um de vocês, caso queiram tentar de novo.

lines.en: I wish I had checked the forecast, because the more clouds I saw, the worse I felt about leaving.
lines.pt: Queria ter olhado a previsão, porque quanto mais nuvens eu via, pior eu me sentia por sair.

lines.en: Take less food, fewer clothes and a lot more water, and always tell somebody where you are going.
lines.pt: Leve menos comida, menos roupa e bem mais água, e sempre avise alguém aonde vai.

lines.en: Let us write a list tonight, in case we forget something, and ask both of the others to review it.
lines.pt: Vamos escrever uma lista hoje à noite, caso esqueçamos algo, e pedir aos outros dois que a revisem.

facts.label: Preparando-se para o imprevisto
facts.sub: got caught, in case it rained, fewer people, each of us.

facts.label: got + particípio
facts.sub: Use got + particípio para imprevistos: Our group got caught in a storm. The path got closed. É informal e foca o resultado, não quem fez.

facts.label: in case + presente / passado
facts.sub: Use in case para precaução: I packed a jacket in case it rained. Não use will depois de in case. Compare com if: If it rains, we will stay.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Got caught means something unexpected happened.

answers: Got caught means something unexpected happened. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “in case it will rain”. → Falso (We say in case it rains.)
Fewer goes with countable nouns. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Getting ready for the unexpected · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cool evening in Denver. Blake sits on the steps of his house. His muddy boots are next to the door. Dan walks up with two cups of tea. They look at the mountains in the distance. Blake begins to tell his story.

“Dan, our group got caught in a storm last weekend, but I had packed a jacket in case it rained.” says Blake. “I heard that. A large number of walkers got stuck, and both of the main paths got closed by the rangers.” says Dan. “Neither of us panicked. Each of us had water and a map in case the signal disappeared, so we stayed calm.” says Blake.
